versions.changelog:
Initial release of call4me skill.

- Lets you have an AI agent phone businesses for bookings, questions, rescheduling, and cancellations.
- Requires connecting to the remote MCP server, signing in with Google or X, and using prepaid credits (starting at $10).
- Guides users through checking balance, setting up their profile, and collecting call details.
- AI agent handles calls, asks required questions, and delivers the outcome with a transcript.
- Only calls businesses (not personal numbers) per user request.
